encoding: WebP with alpha. grokbot's originals ship as he encoded them (128x128, quality 90, alpha 95, method 6); the Codex paintings and the code recolours are 256x256, sharp quality 92, alpha quality 95. Every glyph ships byte for byte as the council approved it (fromSha256 equals sha256).
